# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want participation in this project to be safe and respectful regardless of
experience, background, identity, beliefs, or language proficiency.

## Expected behavior

- Discuss ideas and code, not people's personal qualities.
- Make feedback specific and considerate.
- Acknowledge mistakes and help correct them.
- Respect other participants' privacy, authorship, and boundaries.
- Do not publish credentials, personal data, or sensitive source details.

Insults, threats, harassment, discrimination, sexualized attention, doxxing,
and deliberate disruption of discussions are unacceptable.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit or remove content that violates these rules, restrict
participation, or block a user. A decision should be proportionate to the
behavior and, when practical, explained to the participant.

Report a violation privately to a maintainer using the contact listed on their
GitHub profile. Do not publish incident details in an issue. Reports are handled
confidentially to a reasonable extent; a maintainer involved in a complaint
does not participate in deciding that complaint.

This code applies in the repository, issues, pull requests, discussions, and
other spaces where a person represents the project.
